summary: Backend-only regression run against Excalidraw MCP gateway. 16/16 pytest cases pass covering auth (bearer + no-creds + bogus session_id fast-fail regression), full projects CRUD, per-user isolation (user B gets 404 on list/GET/PATCH/DELETE of user A's project), scene PUT+GET persistence, /simulate element-count increase, MCP proxy behavior (invalid agent_token -> 401, GET works, client-supplied canvasId is IGNORED and elements land only on the token's project), and engine hardening (direct :3100/api/elements requires x-engine-secret; /health stays open).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_scene proxies engine JSON directly to the client; if the engine ever returns non-JSON on error the FastAPI response would still be untyped. Consider wrapping with try/except and returning the persisted Mongo scene as fallback.

mcp_proxy silently swallows client canvasId (correct behavior) but does not log an audit trail. For a security-sensitive isolation guarantee, consider a WARN log when a client attempts to supply a differing canvasId.
persist_project_scene is fired as create_task in mcp_proxy without tracking; on high-frequency writes this can produce a task pile-up. Consider debouncing per project_id.
test_credentials: user_testabc123 / Bearer test_session_token_123; user_testother456 / Bearer test_session_token_other_456; engine secret from /app/backend/.env
seed_data_creation: Both test users already seeded in Mongo (test_database.users + user_sessions). Tests create 2 TEST_ projects and delete them; the fixture teardown removes the primary one, the throwaway is deleted inline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 requested regression areas verified: (1) /api/auth/me 401/200 (2) POST /api/auth/session bogus id → 401 in <2s (measured ~0.2s, no hang) (3) projects CRUD + per-user isolation (user B 404 on all ops) (4) scene PUT then GET returns 2 elements (5) /simulate increments element count (6) MCP proxy: invalid token 401, ?canvasId=someothercanvas ignored (element found on token's project, NOT on bogus canvas queried directly against engine), (7) direct :3100/api/elements → 401 without header, 200 with, /health open. Test file /app/tests/test_gateway.py is idempotent and safe to re-run.
